g.text: Domain Model Excerpt - AA03 Internal Role Resolution (User Aggregate)
- UserId is a unique identifier for a user.
- Must be a string representing the user ID.
influences the roles of the User.
Guest is NOT a role: it is the absence
CUSTOMER is the only role assigned
Every other change is made by an
- Every newly created User receives exactly [CUSTOMER],
assigned inside the aggregate factories (local registration,
first external sign-in, invited account, bootstrap).
Roles are never a creation input.
- Receiving CUSTOMER does not change the activation state:
- Authentication never re-creates a User, never changes its roles
(a revoked CUSTOMER is not restored) and never reactivates it.
- Roles are 0..*: after AA06 removals a User may have no role.
- A User may access protected functionality only if
active == true AND it holds at least one role.
- Roles are always read from this aggregate; roles supplied
by the user, the token or the identity provider are ignored.
